certification.description: Governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder [3]. Standard-marked products carry third-party quality assurance [3].
requirements: All components must be made of specified materials: cow/buffalo curried leather (IS 580 : 1973), brass single roller buckles in 16 mm and 25 mm sizes (IS 4274 : 1981), flax-undyed sewing thread (IS 9543 : 1980), tinned copper hose rivets of 3 mm with washers (IS 2907 : 1964), and shoe maker/saddlers wax with softening point 75°C Min, neutral pH, and penetration of 8-15 units [2, 3].

Cases must conform to the shape and design shown in Figures 1 and 2 [3]. Metallic fasteners must be firmly attached to the leather so that each fastener fits the matching strap cleanly without causing tension or sagging [3].

Stitching must be uniform, neat, and sound, regulated strictly at 28 to 30 stitches per decimetre [3]. Thread must be 4-cord well-twisted and waxed, with sewing by hook awl method strictly prohibited [3]. Stitching must have even tension, be securely finished off, and have loose ends removed [3].
The case dimensions must match Figures 1 and 2, with dimensional tolerances specified in the drawings and leather thickness tolerances conforming strictly to IS 580 : 1973 [3].

Metallic fittings must be free from cracks, seams, scales, burrs, and other defects, with buckle rollers moving freely [3]. Leather edges must be cleanly cut, neatly rubbed, and creased [3]. General workmanship and finish must be good [3].

Each case must be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name or recognized trade-mark, number, and year of manufacture [3]. Standard Mark compliance is governed by BIS licence rules under the BIS Act, 1986 [3].

Unless otherwise agreed, lots are evaluated based on AQL 5 percent visual plans [3]. Sample size depends on lot size (e.g., up to 50: sample size 28, Ac=0; 501-1200: sample size 80, Ac=1; 1201-3200: sample size 125, Ac=3) [3]. Lots conform only when they meet the acceptance numbers for both Table 1 and Table 2 [3].

Detailed laboratory testing is governed by Table 2 attribute sampling plans indexed by lot size (e.g., for lot sizes 2-150: major sample size 5, Ac=0; minor sample size 5, Ac=1; for lot sizes 151-500: major sample size 5, Ac=0; minor sample size 8, Ac=2; for lot sizes 1001-3000: major sample size 20, Ac=2; minor sample size 13, Ac=3) [3].
